presentation.label: SKIPBACK
presentation.summary: Development draft: retain the last minute of stereo MAIN in a configurable recorder buffer.
presentation.overview: Portable capture core with bounded in-place chronological realignment. Native recording, project settings, AED and USB integration are pending.
highlights: R8 and 60 seconds by default; recording starts OFF.
Explicit rearm protects a frozen capture.
usage: Not installable. Proposed access: PROJECT > CONTROL > SKIPBACK. See README.md and INTEGRATION.md.

controls.name: ENABLED
controls.doc: Proposed setting: explicitly start continuous MAIN capture. Project load leaves recording OFF.

controls.name: BUFFER
controls.doc: Proposed setting: exclusive target recorder. Native ownership admission is not implemented.

controls.name: WINDOW
controls.doc: Proposed setting: index + 1 seconds, 1–120; default 60 seconds. Refuse insufficient memory; native limits are unverified.

limitations: Unlisted development draft, not installable firmware.
No native recorder/MAIN adapter, AED publication, project menu/settings storage or USB package.
Core accepts stereo packed 16/24-bit frames at 44.1 kHz; available recorder capacity has not been measured.
No instrument UI, real-time cost, audible output, project persistence or hardware qualification is claimed.

license.declaration: Original Skipback code, tests, documentation and conceptual artwork by fominok. No stock firmware, extracted code/tables, samples or built images.

access.location: Proposed: PROJECT > CONTROL > SKIPBACK; not implemented.
steps: Proposed: open the project menu, choose CONTROL, then SKIPBACK.
Choose the recorder buffer and window, then explicitly enable MAIN capture.
Open the selected recorder in AED to freeze and realign the sample; edit and save with stock AED.
Choose REARM explicitly and confirm replacement before recording again.
